protocol.claim: standalone development gain diagnostic; no runtime integration
protocol.world: unchanged authored memory_world obstacle layout; explicit start/goal override
protocol.driver_input: fixed straight action only; no pose, goal, encoder or task feedback
protocol.perturbation: multiply left_motor scalar gear by .8; right gear/physical radius/track unchanged
protocol.fit: existing fit_wheel_gains: raw shaft increment / measured dt = gain * actual control
protocol.contact_scope: unexpected robot-incident contacts only; all world-only pairs retained and classified separately
protocol.robot_ownership: all descendants of pinned base body; exact robot body/geom names required
protocol.contact_coverage: all ten pre-control position/velocity stages plus final cached pairs; end pairs refer to last pre-integration stage, not a fresh endpoint evaluation
protocol.rejection: any unknown or non-allowlisted robot-incident contact in any interval including settling, callback/pipeline mismatch, early termination, incomplete support, fit bounds or gain disagreement
protocol.threshold_scope: predeclared DEVELOPMENT rejection limits; not physical safety/sensor limits

limitations: Empirical settled torque-control/shaft response; no universal velocity model.
Pre-control contact stages only; cached end contacts, no continuous collision claim.
World-only contacts remain recorded and may move; no static-world/no-world-contact claim.
Standalone authored/model override; no ordinary playback or snapshot restore qualification.
No compensation, online truth correction, held-out, learned or physical safety claim.
World-only contacts are retained, not assumed static.
Fit support is settled development motion at fixed amplitudes; direction dependence remains.
No compensation, modified odometry, held-out controller or physical qualification.
